PrivAgent — Third-Party Model Provenance

This directory (`extension/public/models/` + `dist/models/` after build) contains
pre-trained model weights bundled as extension assets (loaded via
chrome.runtime.getURL, never fetched at runtime).

1. blazeface.onnx (524 KB)
   - Source: manthi4/End-to-end-BlazeFace-Onnx — T_mpipe_bface_boxes_ops16.onnx
     (MediaPipe BlazeFace front, end-to-end NCHW [1,3,128,128] export with 0.7
     confidence threshold + NMS baked into the graph; T_mpipe variant).
   - Retrieved: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/manthi4/End-to-end-BlazeFace-Onnx/main/T_mpipe_bface_boxes_ops16.onnx
   - License: MIT (repository declares MIT; unencumbered for bundling).
   - Modifications: renamed to blazeface.onnx, copied by vite plugin
     copyOnnxAssets (`vite.config.ts`) to dist/models/.

2. icon-detect-640.onnx (12 MB)
   - Source: Derived from Microsoft OmniParser
     https://github.com/microsoft/OmniParser (OmniParser icon detection model,
     640px input, YOLO-based). The ONNX export used here is the conversion
     distributed as icon-detect-640.onnx in this repository.
   - License: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0).
   - Copyright: Microsoft Corporation — see upstream LICENSE.
   - Modifications: converted to ONNX, renamed to icon-detect-640.onnx.
     No functional changes to the detection logic.

AGPL-3.0 Implications

Because `icon-detect-640.onnx` (AGPL-3.0) is bundled into the PrivAgent extension
(`dist/`), the Combined Work as distributed is licensed under AGPL-3.0. See the
repository root LICENSE (AGPL-3.0 full text + PrivAgent additional notice) and
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html.

Corresponding Source for the Combined Work is available at:
  https://github.com/crgs8156-droid/BrowSer_AI
  https://github.com/codesR-cs/BrowSer_AI
including all source, build scripts (vite.config.ts, scripts/), and this directory.

If you distribute a modified version of PrivAgent that still bundles
icon-detect-640.onnx, you must convey it under AGPL-3.0. To keep a build
permissively licensed (MIT), remove icon-detect-640.onnx and the registered
vision provider that loads it (extension/src/perception/visual/providers/
vision-onnx.ts) — the remaining M3–M7 pipeline, blazeface, and Tesseract
assets are MIT/Apache-2.0 compatible.
